description: Defines the FakeProofSourceHandle class used for testing ProofSourceHandle behavior in QUIC, including scripting actions for certificate selection and signature computation.

classes.name: FakeProofSourceHandle
classes.description: A mock implementation of ProofSourceHandle for testing, allowing scripted responses and tracking of certificate selection and signature computation requests.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fake handle with specified actions and delegate.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the handle, marking it as no longer active.

methods.name: SelectCertificate
methods.description: Simulates certificate selection, returning a status based on configured action.

methods.name: ComputeSignature
methods.description: Simulates signature computation, returning a status based on configured action.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns the callback associated with the handle.

methods.name: HasPendingOperation
methods.description: Checks if there is a pending asynchronous operation.
